correctness.rationale: The compactification has bidegree (m,n), is smooth at the toric boundary and in the torus for lambda not 0 or 1, and is irreducible by the simple-zero Kummer valuation. Substituting u=x^m and v=-(1+u)/(1+lambda*u) gives h(u)=(m/n)(lambda-1)u/((1+u)(1+lambda*u)); the two factors have degrees mn and 2. The rotations mu_m x mu_n plus reciprocal involution (alpha/x,beta/y) form 2mn distinct deck transformations with inversion conjugacy, proving Galoisness. Branches at 0,infinity and u=+/-lambda^(-1/2) have partitions m^(2n),n^(2m),2^(mn),2^(mn). Their Riemann-Hurwitz contribution 6mn-2m-2n equals 2g-2+4mn for g=(m-1)(n-1). Recomputed derivative, reciprocal symmetry and sample degree/ramification totals symbolically; those examples alone are not infinite proof.
